title: Claude e Obsidian - Como uma QA utiliza essas ferramentas no dia-a-dia
why_read: A personal workflow post about a QA professional using Obsidian and Claude for note-taking and test organization, useful mainly as a lightweight productivity anecdote.
analysis: This Portuguese-language article describes how a QA engineer uses Obsidian (a local markdown note-taking app) combined with Claude to organize test case documentation and daily QA work. It's a practical personal-productivity story rather than a deep technical dive, focused on tool choice rationale (Obsidian over Notion) and local-first note storage for work security reasons. Useful for readers interested in QA workflows or note-taking setups, but limited generalizable engineering insight.
